title: Task Scheduler
summary: Schedule the supplied jobs on one processor.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10,000 tasks. Each letter is uppercase English. The cooldown n is an integer from 0 through 100.

statement: Schedule the supplied jobs on one processor. Each job needs one time slot. Two jobs with the same letter must have at least n intervening slots. You may reorder jobs and insert idle slots. Return the smallest possible total length. The fixture represents the job letters as one string.

examples.explanation: One valid order is A B idle A B idle A.
There is no cooldown, so no idle slot is needed.
Repeating B C D keeps two slots between copies.

constraints: 1–10,000 tasks. Each letter is uppercase English. The cooldown n is an integer from 0 through 100.
hints: Conceptual: The most frequent letters create the longest repeated pattern.
Directional: Place the maximum-frequency letters in blocks with cooldown-sized gaps.
Implementation: If the maximum count is f and t letters have that count, compare the total jobs with (f−1)(n+1)+t and take the larger.
complexityAnalysis: O(m+A) time and O(A) space for m tasks and alphabet size A, which is 26 here.
